[A1] For an empty record slice, Ledger::verify returns Ok(genesis), the starting digest passed in, since the loop body never runs. For a broken chain it returns Err(LedgerError::Chain) at the first bad record, where a record fails if its prev_root does not equal the running head or its recomputed root does not equal its stored root (no partial head is returned). Any non-empty, fully valid slice returns Ok of the last record's root.
